svg.title: Now Building — RangoNetwork
svg.desc: RangoNetwork, a CCNA v2.0 learning platform built and run on AWS, Kubernetes and Terraform with security checks in CI, drawn as one of its own lesson animations: a commit passes typecheck, tests and a Trivy scan in GitHub Actions, is pushed to Amazon ECR through OIDC and rolled out by Amazon EKS one Kubernetes pod at a time; a learner loads a lesson through Cloudflare Tunnel and the load balancer; metrics and logs land in Grafana.
